snippet.title: Swallow The Sea - FULL PLAY (Short Surreal Swim)
snippet.description:
A no commentary full gameplay of Swallow The Sea. The story of Swallow The Sea is about a lowly egg cell journeying through a swollen sea of strange and humanoid fish. You need to prey on smaller life to grow larger and stronger to perhaps someday be born. Hang on till the ending of Swallow The Sea.

Credits:
Developed by Maceo bob Mair and Nicolás Delgado
Sound Design by Pato Flores and Chris Dang 
Composed by Publio Delgado
